integrity_issues.issue: The pre-registered decision rule picked PILOT_SHARE 0.7, but a check after reading the summary found that uncapped cells plans label more than n items at large pilots (23 of 51 cells over budget at 0.7n, up to 19.7%), so the rule's comparison was not at equal budgets.

deviations.why: The decision rule said to set PILOT_SHARE to s* = 0.7 and pin scripts; taken literally that would ship a share whose gain was partly bought with up to 20% extra labels.

deviations.result: Capped 0.7n gains 5.140 vs 4.417 at 0.5n with coverage >= 93% in all 51 cells; library and tests green.
